verdict.line: You lose this if you walk into Mourning Mist at full value and let Last Rites sustain Yorick through the trade; you win it by trading only when Mourning Mist is down and by collapsing the Maiden the moment it spawns.

brief.thesis: This lane is mechanically even — OP.GG rates lane advantage, solo-kill advantage, and overall shape as EVEN — but Shen's W (Feint) and E (Shadow Dash) taunt directly answer Yorick's entire plan, which is why the measured head-to-head sits at 56.6% over 877 games. Yorick needs you standing still inside Mourning Mist's 700 range and his Dark Procession wall separating you from help; Shen's kit is built to deny exactly those two conditions.

theirWindow.when: Mourning Mist is up and in range
theirWindow.what: Don't extend. Mourning Mist slows, shreds armor, and marks you from 700 range, and his summoned Walkers gain move speed chasing the mark — back off or hold W (Feint) to shield the follow-up auto instead of trading into it.

yourWindow.what: Close with Q (Vorpal Blade, 475 range) and autos. Without the mark his only threat is an empowered Q (Last Rites) auto, and your Ki Strike passive is resetting in the same exchange.

start.why: 71.1% pick rate and 54.5% win rate over 754 games — the regen and block-on-hit absorb Last Rites empowered autos and standard poke without you spending sustain cooldowns.

boots.why: 78.5% pick rate at 56.1% win over 786 games; Yorick's damage is entirely physical autos (empowered Last Rites hits included), so the flat reduction directly undercuts his trade pattern.

core.why: First item in the highest-win-rate path (65.2% over 66 games); the cleave sustains you through wave-clear trades where Yorick leans on Last Rites healing.
Second item on the same measured path; adds the durability needed to stand in taunt-range during E (Shadow Dash) all-ins.
Completes the 65.2%-win-rate path and punishes Yorick's auto-reliant Last Rites and Maiden-buffed attacks directly.
Listed among the common later items for this matchup; scales your health total for both lane tankiness and teamfight frontlining.

situational.when: yorick or another enemy carry builds attack speed/crit to punish your auto-heavy trading
yorick rushes lifesteal or heavy on-hit items early to out-sustain your Last Rites trades
the enemy team has a burst magic threat alongside yorick that outpaces your physical-focused build
you want extra wave-clear and poke utility over pure thornmail-style tankiness

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-win-rate page for this matchup (57.8%, 39.4% pick) — the proc sustains you through the exact extended auto-trades Yorick's Last Rites is built around, and the bonus health scales both lane tankiness and later frontlining.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the highest measured win rate for this matchup (55.6% over a 29% pick rate) and compounds Shen's own global kit — Teleport lets you reset top after committing R (Stand United) elsewhere. Flash+Ignite (54.5%, 68.7% pick) is the more common pick if you'd rather pressure the lane-kill directly.

playing.title: Break the wall with autos
playing.detail: Yorick's W (Dark Procession) wall is destructible; a few basic attacks collapse it before it fully separates you from minions or allies, so don't path around it into the unknown.

playing.title: Respect the 700-range Mourning Mist
playing.detail: E (Mourning Mist, 12/11/10/9/8s cd) slows, shreds armor, and marks you from 700 range. Step outside that range before committing so his Walkers don't get the chase-speed bonus off the mark.

playing.title: Trade only when his E is down
playing.detail: With Mourning Mist on cooldown, close with Q (Vorpal Blade, 475 range) and autos, holding W (Feint) to shield whatever burst comes back.

playing.title: Taunt through his combo
playing.detail: E (Shadow Dash, 575 range, 16/14/12/10/8s cd) taunts on contact, locking him into attacking you and denying the repositioning he needs to land Last Rites cleanly.

playing.title: Kill the Maiden first after level 6
playing.detail: Once R (Eulogy of the Isles) is up, Yorick's bonus damage comes from attacking alongside the Maiden against its marked target — disengage from or focus the Maiden before trading, per OP.GG's own read on this matchup.

playing.title: Use your R to swing other lanes
playing.detail: Stand United's 25000 range and ally teleport are a bigger lever than forcing a top-side win in a lane that's measured EVEN — abandon parity here to save or win fights elsewhere.

playing.title: Don't start trades with Last Rites already ticking
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade vs Last Rites head-on is close, but Last Rites heals Yorick on the hit — initiate with W (Feint) available so his reactive sustain doesn't outpace your own Q healing.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, boots, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG data on patch 16.19.1 across the 877-game Shen vs Yorick sample. The tactical reasoning — wall-breaking, Mourning Mist range management, Maiden prioritization — is my own read on the mechanics, not a claim OP.GG makes directly.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Yorick’s (E). Use basic attacks to break free of Yorick’s (W) quickly when [E] is on cooldown. After reaching level 6, get rid of Yorick’s Maiden of the Mist first to get the upper hand in combat.
